title: Identification of VWA5A as a novel biomarker for inhibiting metastasis in breast cancer by machine-learning based protein prioritization
summary: A machine-learning recursive feature-addition/LOOCV workflow prioritized VWA5A from a 29-patient breast-cancer proteomics discovery set; its association with disease-free survival was examined in METABRIC (n=1,904; HR 0.71, 95% CI 0.58–0.85), with weaker discrimination (c-index 0.543). This supports an exploratory biomarker candidate, not causal inhibition or clinical utility.
organization: Department of Pathology, Seoul National University Hospital, Seoul National University College of Medicine, Seoul, South Korea
